## 1. Quicksort

```python
import random

def quicksort(arr: list) -> list:
    """
    Quicksort – a divide-and-conquer sorting algorithm.

    Strategy:
      1. Pick a "pivot" element from the array.
      2. Partition the remaining elements into two groups:
         • left  → elements ≤ pivot
         • right → elements >  pivot
      3. Recursively sort each group, then concatenate:
         sorted_left + [pivot] + sorted_right

    Time Complexity:
      • Average : O(n log n)
      • Worst   : O(n²)   (already-sorted input with bad pivot choice)
    Space Complexity: O(n)  (due to list copies in this functional version)
